subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A city added shade structures over sidewalks near hospitals, bus stops, and schools.”?
options: After using the press, students respected old books more.
Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.
A student using a wheelchair helped create a map of accessible routes around school.
The box helped students speak without fear.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After using the press, students respected old books more.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student using a wheelchair helped create a map of accessible routes around school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The box helped students speak without fear.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.」，答案為「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students helped survey people using the shaded routes.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
